server_addr
Description
Returns the IP address of the server. This is a BIG-IP version 4.X
variable, provided for backward compatibility. You can use the
equivalent 9.X command
IP::server_addr
instead.
Syntax
server_addr
server_addr
Returns the IP address of the server.
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL_EVENTS
